Chinese vloggers in Bangladesh are allegedly misrepresenting Dhaka’s slums as New Delhi, spreading anti-India propaganda on social media. Why are over 150 Chinese content creators targeting India? Explore the investigation, viral misinformation, WeChat livestreams, India-China relations, and the controversy behind this campaign.
